title: Size Potions
description: Size Potions adds a Potion of Normalization that temporarily resets any player or entity to default scale. Health scales dynamically with size to keep gameplay balanced.
body:
## Size Potions
Size Potions adds a new item to your server, the Potion of Normalization. This potion temporarily resets any player or entity to scale 1.0, restoring normal size and reach for a limited time.

This plugin was built for an SMP where custom player sizes caused balance issues. Smaller players had strong advantages. Larger players struggled with reach, builds, and mobility. Size Potions solves this by giving everyone access to temporary normalization.

When the effect is active:
- The entity’s vanilla scale attribute is set to 1.0
- Health adjusts dynamically based on size
- Small players have fewer hearts
- Large players have more hearts
Health scaling is based on logarithmic scale differences, which keeps changes smooth instead of extreme.

### Recipes
- **Size Potion 3 minutes**
Thick Potion + Golden Carrot in a crafting table
- **Extended 8 minutes**
Size Potion + Redstone Dust
- **Splash Potion**
Size Potion any duration + Gunpowder

![Picture of the recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjom19/SizePotions/3beac14d640f0a6c33f8cb38e6d2c0be5aaf7953/assets/Screenshot%202026-03-09%20170649.png)

### Configuration
You have full control over scaling limits and health balance:
- **base_health**
Base health for scale 1.0
- **health_step**
Controls how dramatic health differences are per ln scale unit
- **min_health**
Absolute minimum health safety limit
- **min_scale and max_scale**
Defines the allowed size range on your server

The plugin modifies the vanilla scale attribute and uses the Luck effect internally for tracking.
- Includes a simple command: /playersize <player> <float> to quickly set a player’s scale within the allowed range

### Future Plans
- Potions for increasing and decreasing size

This plugin was originally made for an SMP server. If you find bugs or want new features, open an issue or suggest improvements on GitHub.

FishSMP Network LLC approved ✅
